reviews.text:
there will always be a special place in my heart for the fwee pudding pots - note i use these primarily for lips rather than cheeks. 
this is the first time i have tried this viral without shade - and also first time ive bought very light shades in this collection. i have to say that the effect is kinda clumpy and white - much harder to blend than the darker colours. i have to use my fingers to get a smooth and flat/blurry finish (i usually use the applicator but the applicator makes the light shades clumpy)
i love that you get a full size limited edition shade in this pack but also these shades were just too light for my skin (im between 20 to 21) and makes my look lifeless. which is why i would much prefer to use them on the cheeks than the lips. 
its also really comfortable on the lips, smooth, blurry and long lasting
tldr: i love this formula but respectfully i will stick to darker shades as they suit me more
reviews.zh:
fwee 布甸罐系列永遠佔住我心入面一個特別位置——注意，我主要用嚟塗唇，而唔係面頰。
呢次係我第一次試呢款爆紅嘅 without shade，亦係第一次買呢個系列嘅好淺色。我必須講，效果有啲結塊同發白，比深色難推開好多。我要用手指先可以做到平滑、平貼／模糊嘅效果（我通常會用塗抹器，但塗抹器會令淺色結塊）。
我好鍾意呢包裝入面有一個全尺寸嘅限定色，但係呢啲色號對我嚟講實在太淺，令我嘅樣子睇落冇生氣。所以我更加想用喺面頰，而唔係用喺嘴唇。
塗喺唇上都好舒服，順滑、模糊，而且持久。
總結：我好鍾意呢個配方，但係恕我直言，我會繼續用深色，因為深色更適合我。

reviews.text:
TEXTURE 🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡 
I love the fluffy pudding texture. It does a great job filling in the lip creases and giving a soft finish. Lips look plump and matte. It also stays on pretty well, longer than lip gloss.

COLORS ARE VERY DIFFERENT IRL 🧡🧡🧡 🤍🤍
The colors look very different when applied. You're just gonna have to try it and see. You'd need to completely concealer-off your lips to achieve the soft gradient you see in product photos.

FYI my skin tone is Warm Muted Autumn.
ND04 MY- looks like orange-coral on my skin tone.
RS03 FADED- looks like darker, red brown on my skin tone.

PUDDING POT 🧡🧡🤍🤍🤍
You definitely should get the silicone brush as it is extremely difficult to reach the product with your fingers without getting it in your nails. Also, once the product gets mushy from use, it's hard to get a precise amount. The product tends to cluster and stick. I ended up wasting quite a bit of product.
reviews.zh:
質地 🧡🧡🧡🧡🧡
我好鍾意布甸一樣嘅蓬鬆質地。佢好好地填補咗唇紋，令唇部睇落柔和。嘴唇睇落飽滿同啞光。佢亦都幾耐用，比唇彩持久。

實物顏色同相差好遠 🧡🧡🧡 🤍🤍
塗上去嗰陣顏色好唔同。你一定要自己試吓先知。要將自己原本嘅唇色完全遮蓋，先可以做到產品相入面嗰種柔和漸層效果。

補充一句，我嘅膚色係 Warm Muted Autumn（暖色啞光秋季）。
ND04 MY 喺我嘅膚色上睇落似橙珊瑚色。
RS03 FADED 喺我嘅膚色上睇落似深啲嘅紅棕色。

布甸罐 🧡🧡🤍🤍🤍
你一定要買矽膠刷，因為用手指好難拎到產品，又容易黏晒指甲。另外，產品用多咗之後會變得軟糊，好難控制用量。產品容易結塊同黏住，我最後浪費咗好多產品。

reviews.text:
This shade (BS01 Cool) is a beautiful color. I was waiting for Fwee to release a very cool-toned shade in this product line, because most blushes tend to pull too warm and bright on my skin tone. As you can see in the swatches on my hand, this blush sheers out very easily-- so you can wear it as a bright pink, a subdued pink, or a very pale pink. Applied on my face, you can see more of the purple tones in the blush, and it becomes a lavender pink. 

On the lips: It applies very smoothly and easily. It looks more purple-leaning on my lips, which I love. On the negative side, it is quite drying (I have dry lips). It also wipes off very easily, so it doesn't have much staying power. 

On the cheeks: It takes more effort to blend on the cheeks. First I blended with my fingers, then I used a makeup sponge to blend it more fully. This might be because I prefer a lighter, subtler shade of pink blush, and this looked quite bright on me before blending.
reviews.zh:
呢個色號（BS01 Cool）好靚。我一直等緊 Fwee 喺呢個產品系列推出一款好冷色調嘅色號，因為大部分腮紅喺我嘅膚色上都會偏暖、偏亮。如你見到手背上嘅色卡，呢款腮紅好易淡化——所以你可以塗成鮮粉色、柔和粉色，或者好淺嘅粉色。塗喺面上嗰陣，你可以見到更多紫色調，變成薰衣草粉色。

塗喺唇上：塗抹好順滑、好容易。塗喺唇上會偏紫色，我好鍾意。缺點係，佢幾乾身（我嘴唇乾）。亦都好容易擦走，所以持久力唔算好。

塗喺面頰上：要花多啲功夫先推開。我先用手指推，然後再用化妝海綿推得更勻。可能係因為我比較鍾意淺色、柔和嘅粉色腮紅，而呢款喺推開前睇落好鮮亮。

reviews.text:
I wrote a previous review about the shade crush. The shade like is great on dark skin with a lip liner for the perfect baby pink gradient or full pouty lip! It’s lasts for an average amount of time so you’d definitely have to reapply.

I also top these pudding pots with lip gloss and the texture comes out quite nice but does make it last for less time before reapplying.

I only docked a star for the fact that it doesn’t come with its on applicator to keep it hygienic.
reviews.zh:
我之前寫過一個關於 shade crush 色號嘅評價。呢個色號喺深膚色上好好，配合唇線筆，可以做出完美嘅嬰兒粉色漸層或者飽滿嘟嘟唇！持久度一般，所以一定要補塗。

我亦會喺呢啲布甸罐上面加唇彩，質地幾好，但係會令持久度短啲，要比較早補。

我只係因為佢冇附送獨立嘅塗抹器，以保持衛生，而扣咗一粒星。

reviews.text: There is a reason why these are so popular right now. They have so many colors to choose from in different color stories, they are pigmented, soft with a bit of a lasting tint, and overall fun to use. Mule, while in the red color family is a bit on the pinky side, but still a nice cool toned shade. They do look darker and more muted in the pot but once you apply them the colors are quite vibrant.
reviews.zh: 呢啲產品而家咁受歡迎係有原因嘅。佢哋喺唔同色系入面有好多色號可以揀，發色好、質地軟、有少少持久嘅染色效果，整體用落好好玩。Mule 屬紅色系，但有少少偏粉，不過仍然係一款好靚嘅冷色調。佢哋喺盒入面睇落深啲、啞啲，但係一塗喺身上顏色就好鮮豔。

reviews.text:
The color range of this pudding pot is crazy. I managed to controlled myself and selected 7 out of the 30 shades to try with. They are all very pretty colors and its first time ever that every shades I bought suit my skin tone perfectly. This is magic! The texture is also wonderful and it is appleid very smoothly on both my lip and cheek with excellent cover even very little was used. And once its applied on the lips the product sit tight and doesnt move at all unless you eat or drink. 
I really wanted more shades, wish they could release more key chains kit on other shades too cuz the key chains are so cute! 
The swatched from right to left are: OH!, Without, My, Baby, Skirt, Seventeen and Lyric. 
My favorite for cheeks is Without and they all look amazing on my lips. 
( I usually get N17 or lightest shade foundation in K make-up with yellow skin tone. )
reviews.zh:
呢款布甸罐嘅色號選擇多到誇張。我忍住冇買太多，喺 30 個色號入面揀咗 7 個嚟試。全部都係好靚嘅顏色，而且係第一次，我買嘅每一個色號都完美啱我嘅膚色。好神奇！質地都好好，而且就算只係用一點點，都可以塗得好順滑，唇同面頰都遮蓋力好好。塗咗喺唇上之後，產品好穩定貼實，除非食嘢或者飲嘢，否則完全唔會郁。
我真係想要多啲色號，希望佢哋可以推出其他色號嘅鎖匙扣套裝，因為鎖匙扣實在好可愛！
由右至左嘅色卡（swatches）係：OH!、Without、My、Baby、Skirt、Seventeen 同 Lyric。
我最鍾意用喺面頰嘅係 Without，而佢哋塗喺唇上全部都好靚。
（我通常揀 K make-up 嘅 N17，或者最淺色粉底，我膚色偏黃。）

reviews.text:
Hands-down the best matte type formula I’ve tried!
It blurs out all of the lines in my lips and makes them look fluffier somehow?

It lasts a few hours on me and is super comfortable to wear. It honestly feels like there is nothing on my lips, as it isn’t cakey or drying.

For anyone trying to pick out a color, just note that the shades appear a bit lighter on the lips than in the container.
reviews.zh:
係我試過最好嘅啞光質地！
佢可以模糊掉嘴唇上嘅所有紋路，令唇部睇落唔知點解好似更加蓬鬆？

喺我身上可以維持幾個鐘，戴落好舒服。老實講，感覺好似唇上冇嘢咁，因為佢唔會厚重起餅，亦唔會乾燥。

如果你揀緊色號，請留意色號喺唇上睇落會比喺盒入面淺少少。

reviews.text: As a person with really dry lips I dont reccomend this. Its really drying but the color blends out really well but it also does go away really fast with just one wipe and it doesnt always get to a darker color I want.
reviews.zh: 我嘴唇好乾，所以我唔推薦呢款。佢真係好乾，顏色推得開，但係只要擦一下就好快脫色，而且亦未必可以達到我想要嘅深色。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
